findings.highlight: One year ago, I stopped having to rely on medicine anymore to treat my "mental damage as a result of overworking," as the doctors decided to interpret my symptoms as.
findings.evidenceJa: 一年前『身に余る仕事量とプレッシャーの大きさによるメンタルダメージ』と随分好意的に解釈された例の症状は、もう、薬に頼る必要もなくなるほどに落ち着いてきた。
findings.explanation: The symptoms were charitably diagnosed a year ago as damage from overwork and pressure; only now have they subsided enough that Haruki no longer needs medication. Todokanai TL moves stopping medication back one year and leaves the present recovery without a predicate.
findings.japanese:
一年前『身に余る仕事量とプレッシャーの大きさによる
メンタルダメージ』と随分好意的に解釈された例の症状は、
もう、薬に頼る必要もなくなるほどに落ち着いてきた。
findings.todokanai: One year ago, I stopped having to rely on medicine anymore to treat my "mental damage as a result of overworking," as the doctors decided to interpret my symptoms as.

findings.highlight: certain things would cause my nerves to stop listening to me
findings.evidenceJa: 何かきっかけがあるとすぐに自律神経が言うことを聞かなくなり
findings.explanation: Haruki says that for about six months any trigger could immediately throw his autonomic nervous system out of regulation. Generic 'nerves' suggests anxiety or disobedient body sensations and erases the concrete physiological aftermath of his breakdown.
findings.japanese:
とはいえ半年間くらいは、何かきっかけがあると
すぐに自律神経が言うことを聞かなくなり、
随分と周囲に迷惑を掛けたものだった。
findings.todokanai: But even then, for half a year, certain things would cause my nerves to stop listening to me, which caused those around me considerable trouble.

findings.highlight: It's not strong enough to leave a mark in their hearts.
findings.evidenceJa: 心をガツンと殴るほど強くない。けれど、優しく包み込む。なのに、華がある。
findings.explanation: Haruki contrasts Setsuna's non-punching vocal style with its enveloping gentleness and glamour. Todokanai TL turns 'not forceful enough to punch you in the heart' into the disparaging claim that her singing cannot leave an emotional mark, undercutting the praise that structures the passage.
findings.japanese:
心をガツンと殴るほど強くない。
けれど、優しく包み込む。
なのに、華がある。
findings.todokanai: It's not strong enough to leave a mark in their hearts. Rather, her voice gently envelops us, though there's also a brilliant quality to it.

findings.evidenceJa: 空から降りてくる粉雪は、ますますその数を増やしていく。
findings.explanation: This is ordinary fine, powdery snow in the reprise of the opening image, not the separately load-bearing English song title 'Powder Snow.' Using the exact song title here collapses an intentional distinction between the weather motif and the named song.
findings.japanese:
まだ耳に残る雪菜の歌をかき消すように、
空から降りてくる粉雪は、
ますますその数を増やしていく。
findings.todokanai: And now, as if to drown out the sound of Setsuna's singing, the scattering powder snow descending from the heavens grows ever more dense.

findings.highlight: I'm giving Setsuna no choice but to protect me.
findings.evidenceJa: 雪菜に、護ってもらうしかなくなる。
findings.explanation: Haruki says he will again be reduced to having no choice but to rely on Setsuna to protect him. Todokanai TL transfers the lack of choice to Setsuna, making him compel her instead of confessing his dependency.
findings.japanese:
だって俺は、また雪菜に迷惑をかける。
雪菜に、護ってもらうしかなくなる。
findings.todokanai: Because I'm causing Setsuna trouble again. I'm giving Setsuna no choice but to protect me.

findings.highlight: The time we decided on was 6 o'clock, wasn't it?
findings.evidenceJa: 春希くんとこの定時って６時だったよね？
findings.explanation: Setsuna says Haruki's official quitting time at work is six, so proposing an eight-o'clock start already assumes two hours of overtime. Todokanai TL invents a previously agreed six-o'clock appointment and loses the workplace joke.
findings.japanese:
「８時ぃ？
春希くんとこの定時って６時だったよね？
そりゃ、普段は忙しいのはわかるけどさぁ」
findings.todokanai: "8 o'clock? The time we decided on was 6 o'clock, wasn't it? I get that you're busy, though."

findings.evidenceJa: お前、結構したたかになったなぁ
findings.explanation: したたか here means shrewd, formidable, or calculating: Setsuna has learned how to bargain with Haruki. 'Stubborn' misidentifies the trait and misses her deliberately canny demand.
findings.japanese:
「雪菜…
お前、結構したたかになったなぁ」

findings.highlight: I've begun to talk to this foolish girl who's so dear to me.
findings.evidenceJa: いつの間にか『お前』って呼び捨てられるくらい、愚かで、愛しい女が。
findings.explanation: The narration explicitly marks that Haruki has grown close enough to call Setsuna お前 without a name or title. Todokanai TL deletes the quoted address form and the relationship milestone, replacing it with the contentless statement that he has begun to talk to her.
findings.japanese:
いつの間にか『お前』って呼び捨てられるくらい、
愚かで、愛しい女が。
findings.todokanai: Before I even realized it, I've begun to talk to this foolish girl who's so dear to me.

findings.evidenceJa: 本当に、いい性格になったよ
findings.explanation: いい性格 is sarcastic here: after Setsuna's barb about being loved second-most, Haruki says she has developed quite a nasty or formidable personality. 'Good-natured' reverses the joke into sincere praise.
findings.japanese: 「…本当に、いい性格になったよ」

findings.highlight: leaving us there in its wake.
findings.evidenceJa: ただ白く、綺麗なだけの世界を目の前に広げ、俺たちを、そこに閉じこめようとする。
findings.explanation: The snow spreads a merely white and beautiful world before them and tries to imprison them inside it. Todokanai TL deletes the active attempt at confinement, the central danger in Haruki's fantasy of a purified two-person world, and substitutes the semantically unrelated 'in its wake.'
findings.japanese:
ただ白く、綺麗なだけの世界を目の前に広げ、
俺たちを、そこに閉じこめようとする。
findings.todokanai: A white world abundant only in beauty expands before our eyes, leaving us there in its wake.

findings.highlight: all of the hidden truths and forgotten emotions it had been hiding will once again be brought into daylight for all to see.
findings.evidenceJa: 一度解けたら、のたうち回って生き抜いた過去を、二度と忘れたらいけない思い出を、もう一度、俺たちの心に呼び戻す。
findings.explanation: When snow melts, it summons back into their hearts the past they writhed through and survived, and the memories they must never again forget. Todokanai TL invents hidden truths, already-forgotten emotions, daylight, and public exposure, erasing both survival and the moral duty to remember.
findings.japanese:
一度解けたら、のたうち回って生き抜いた過去を、
二度と忘れたらいけない思い出を、
もう一度、俺たちの心に呼び戻す。
findings.todokanai: Once it melts, all of the hidden truths and forgotten emotions it had been hiding will once again be brought into daylight for all to see.
